  "body": "Quarry 3.2 makes restores of big databases fast and stops the restore error people hit most.

## Highlights

### Restores stream in parallel
`quarry restore` now streams tables in parallel instead of one at a time. On our 40 GB benchmark database a restore went from 38 minutes to 6 minutes. Set the number of workers with `--jobs` (the default is the number of CPU cores).

![quarry restore with --jobs 8](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5f0c2a1e-7d43-4b8e-9a61-2c3e8f1d4b70)

### No more "out of shared memory"
Large restores used to stop with `ERROR: out of shared memory` (HINT: You might need to increase max_locks_per_transaction). Quarry 3.2 takes its locks one table at a time, so that error is gone. Fixes #812.

### `quarry diff` shows row counts
`quarry diff <snapshot> <target>` now prints each table's row count on both sides and what changed.

![quarry diff with row counts](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a93e6b02-1c5d-4f7a-8e29-6d0b4c7f3e15)

## Other changes
- `quarry snapshot --exclude` accepts globs (#790)
- Postgres 17 is supported (#801)
- Postgres 12 is no longer supported; it reached end of life (#805)

## Upgrade
```
brew upgrade quarry
```
or `curl -fsSL https://get.quarry.example/install.sh | sh`

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/acme/quarry/compare/v3.1.4...v3.2.0
"
